tei:div.tei:p: (pha)༄༅// sgyu ma bde ba chen po'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba bzhugs so// ༄༅// dpal sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor gyi cho ga dbang rnam par rol pa zhes bya ba/ sgyu ma chen mo la phyag 'tshal lo// sna tshogs sgyu ma'i thabs tshul gyis// srid pa'i sgyu ma las grol nas// sgyu 'phrul drwa ba gang brnyes pa'i// sgyu ma che la phyag 'tshal lo// sangs rgyas gar mkhan rol pa bzhin// rdo rje slob dpon rnam rol pas// slob ma bde la rol byed pa'i// dbang bskur rnam par rol pa bshad// slob dpon dang ni slob ma nyid// phan tshun mtshan nyid ldan rig nas// gnas dus yo byad phun tshogs pas// dbang bskur ba yi cho ga brtsam// sngon du 'gro dang lhag gnas dang*// dkyil 'khor dngos gzhi'i bya ba dang*// de bzhin mjug gi cho ga ste// rnam pa bzhis ni yang dag bsdus// de'ang ji skad bshad pa'i mtshan nyid dang ldan pa'i bla ma la/ sngags kyi lam gyis mchog gi byang chub don du gnyer ba'i slob ma rnams kyis/ phyag dang maṇḍal sngon du song bas/ byang chub kyi bar gyi bla ma nyid du gsol ba btab nas/ de la dbang blang ba'i blos/ khyod zhabs padma spangs nas ni// gtso bo gzhan nas skyabs ma mchis// 'gro ba'i dpa' bo thab chen gyis// blo mchog bdag ni gnang bar mdzod// ces lan gsum du gsol ba gdab bo// bla mas kyang yo byad dang nus pa dris nas/ nus shing 'byor par khas len na/ kho bos ji ltar nus pa'i rjes su gzung gis/ khyod kyis kyang bag yod par byos shig ces bsgos nas/ sngon chad lam la ma zhugs na/ ji ltar spro ba'i dge bsnyen gyi sdom pa dang*/ byang chub kyi mchog tu sems bskyed pa byin nas so so'i bslab bya'ang bstan la slob tu gzhug go /de nas slob ma la gnod par byed pa'i bgegs la/ na massarba ta thā ga te bhyo/ bi shwa mu khe bhyaḥ sarba thā khaṃ uṅga te spha ra ṇa/

i maṃ ga ga na khaṃ grihṇe daṃ ba liṃ ta ye swā hā'i sngags kyis gtor ma byin la/ ting lo dang chang bu rngan par sbyin zhing sumbha'i sngags kyis bsdigs nas gu gul gyis bdug yungs kar gyis brab/ drag po'i sngags dang ting nge 'dzin gyis bskrad do// de nas de'i sdig pa kam̐ gi rnam pas phyung zhing til la bstim pas/ ye shes kyi me dang rgya mtshor dmigs pa'i me dang chur dor zhing*/ oṃ badzra ḍā ka kha kha khā hi khā hi sarba pā paṃ da ha na bhasmiṃ ku ru swā hā/ zhes brjod pas sdig pa sbyang ngo*// de nas oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta a bhi ṣe ka ta sa ma ya shrī hūm̐ gis/ mngon par bsngags pa'i chus bag chags kyi dri ma bkrus nas gnas gsum yi ge gsum gyis bsrung ngo*// slob ma gzung ba'o// de nas bsnyen pa'i yo byad slob mas sbyar nas bum pa la brten pa lha sta gon ltar ram/ ma brten pa bskyed rim ltar dngos sam rmi lam du gnang ba thob kyi bar ram/ gtso bo la 'bum phrag brgyad dang*/ 'khor la khri phrag brgyad kyi bzlas pa bya'o// bsnyen pa'o// //de nas dur khrod dam/ chu 'gram mam/ bas mtha' la sogs pa dben zhing nyams dga' la 'tshe ba med cing yo byad phun sum tshogs pa kha dog dang dbyibs dang mtshan ma bzang po dang ldan pa dkyil 'khor gyi gzhir 'os par shes pa dang*/ thog mar mngon pa las bslangs nas lha'i rnal 'byor dang ldan pas mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams la legs par byugs pa'i maṇḍal gyi dbus su/ me tog gi tshom bu lnga bkod pa/ skad cig gis dkyil 'khor rdzogs par mos par yongs rdzogs su bsgrubs nas/ gtor ma'i bar gyis mchod la/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs te/ rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ bde gshegs thams cad bdag la dgongs// khyed rnams mchod pa'i phyir dang ni// slob ma rnams la phan phyir du// sgyu 'phrul chen mo zhes bya yi// dkyil 'khor bzang po bri bar 'tshal// bdag la byin rlabs gnang bar mdzod// ces lan gsum gsol ba btab pas/

rjes su gnang zhing byin gyis brlab par bsgoms nas gshegs su gsol te tshom bu rnams bsdu ba'o// gnang ba zhu ba'o// de nas de nyid du slar yang me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod pa/ padma dang zla ba'i steng du lam̐ las byung ba'i sa'i lha mo ser mo phyag gnyis kyis rin po che'i bum pa 'dzin zhing rgyan thams cad kyis brgyan pa phyogs skyong dang*/ gzhi bdag gis bskor ba bskyed nas gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ sa bon gyi 'od dang lag pa g.yas pa sa la lan gsum bsnun pas rang bzhin du gnas pa bkug nas bstim ste dbang bskur nas/ rin chen 'byung ldan gyi rgyas btab pa la/ gtor ma'i bar gyis mchod nas rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas/ skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// spyod pa'i tshul dang khyad par gyis// sa dang pha rol phyin pa la// lha mo khyod ni dpang du gyur// skyob pa sangs rgyas thams cad kyis// ji ltar bdud kyi sde bcom pa// de bzhin bdag gis bdud sde las// rgyal bar byas te dkyil 'khor bri// zhes lan gsum brjod pa'i mthar/ rdo rje slob dpon bdag la slob ma che ge mo zhes bya bas bskul nas/ sems can thams cad sangs rgyas kyi sa la dgod pa'i phyir phyogs 'dir/ sgyu ma chen mo'i dkyil 'khor bzhengs nas dbang bskur bar bgyid par 'tshal na sa'i phyogs 'di bdag la gnang zhing grogs mdzad du gsol// zhes gsol ba gdab bo// phyogs skyong gzhi bdag dang bcas pa la'ang gtor ma byin nas/ sa phyogs 'dir gnas lha dang klu// gnod sbyin dri za lha ma yin// gang dag rdzu 'phrul che ldan pa// rdo rje'i spyan dang snyan ldan rnams// bdag la dgongs par mdzad du gsol// bdag ming 'di zhes bgyi ba yis// bde gshegs rnams la mchod pa dang*// sems can kun la phan pa'i phyir// dge ba'i sa phyogs 'di nyid du// dkyil 'khor dam pa cher 'byung ba// sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i rgyud kyi rgyal// dkyil 'khor chen po'i las byed pas// khyed kyis bar chad ma byed par// dge ba'i grogs po nyid du mdzod// ces lan gsum brjod pas de dag thams cad kyis ji ltar dga' ba byos shig ces gnang ba byin nas de nyid du thim pa dang*/

so so'i gnas su gshegs par bsam mo// mi mngon pa las bslang ba ste sa bslang ba'o// dgun zla 'bring po nas brtsams te// zla ba gsum gsum lto 'phye'i mgo /shar dang lho dang nub dang byang*// bltas te g.yon pa'i zur gyis nyal// pus mo lto ba rked tsam du// dngos grub rjes mthun lto nas brko// zhes pa'i tshul gyis sol ba dang gseg ma dang gyo mo dang rus pa la sogs pa'i zug rngu rnams phyungs nas/ sman dang 'bru dang rin po che dang bcas pa'i sa brnyan bzang pos bkang la bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags bzlas pa'i bum pa'i chus bran zhing 'thas par brdungs te dbus mtho zhing shar dang byang gzhol ba me long gi ngos ltar 'jam pa'i sa stegs ji ltar rigs pa bya'o// brkor mi rung ba la ni/ oṃ ha na ha na kro dha hūm̐ phaṭa kyi sngags kyis zug rngu sbyangs nas sa brnyan bzang po'i sa stegs brtsigs pas rung ba nyid do// zug rngu sbyang ba'o// de nas slob dpon gyis dbus su kha shar du phyogs te 'dug la/ bhu khaṃ dang swa bhā was sa phyogs stong par bsgoms nas hūm̐ lam̐ hūm̐ las rdo rje'i sa gzhir bskyed la/ oṃ me di nī badzrī bha wa bandha hūm̐ gis byin gyis brlabs pa'i steng du pam̐ dang ram̐ las padma dang nyi ma'i dbus su sna tshogs rdo rje hūm̐ gis mtshan pa las byung ba'i srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par bsgoms nas/ oṃ badzra rakṣa rakṣa hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa kyis byin gyis brlabs te/ de'i dbus su rang nyid skad cig gis dpal he ru kar dmigs pa'i thugs ka nas phur bu dang tho ba 'dzin pa'i khro bo'i tshogs du ma spros pas phyogs skyong bcu 'khor dang bcas pa'i bgegs kyi tshogs srung 'khor gyi phyi rol du bkug la dkar po'i phyogs rnams lam la bkod cing*/ nag po'i phyogs rnams kyi spyi bor phur bu btab nas/ oṃ gha gha ghā ta ya ghā ta ya/ sarba duṣṭāṃ phaṭa/

kī la ya kī la ya sarba pā paṃ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ badzra kī la ya badzra dha ra ā dzñā pa ya ti sarba bighnān kā ya wāka tsitta/ badzra kī la ya hūm̐ hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod nas rdo rje tho bas brdung par bsam zhing*/ oṃ badzra mutka ra badzra kī la ya/ ā ko ta ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod pas lus thal ba'i phung por gyur zhing sems kyi sgrib pa sbyangs nas mi bskyod pa'i zhing du sangs rgyas/ khro bo rnams rdo rje'i rwa ba'i kha khyer la 'khod nas srung ba'i las mdzad par bsam mo// bgegs sbyang ba ste sa sbyangs pa'o// de nas phyogs bzhir 'khod pa'i las kyi slob ma dang bcas pa'i gtso 'khor lngas dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgoms nas mthar lha so so'i nga rgyal 'dzin pas slob dpon ting nge 'dzin las bslang ba'i phyir/ phyogs bzhi'i slob mas rim pa bzhin// de bzhin gshegs pa kun zhi ba// de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyis gnas// chos kun bdag med pa yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// mtshan rnams thams cad yang dag rdzogs// mtshan min thams cad rnam spangs pa// kun tu bzang po sku yi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhi ba'i chos ni mchog las byung*// ye shes spyod pa rnam sbyong mdzad// kun tu bzang po gsung gi mchog /dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// sems can kun gyi sems chen po// rang bzhin dag pas dri ma med// kun bzang thugs mchog kha lo bsgyur// dkyil 'khor dam pa bshad du gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab pas/ slob dpon ting nge 'dzin las langs te/ oṃ badzro tiṣṭhas ting nge 'dzin gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg la/ rang nyid gtso bo las bye ba'i he ru kar dmigs pa'i mig gnyis ma dang ṭa las nyi ma dang zla ba hūm̐ gis mtshan par dmigs nas g.yon nas g.yas dang*/ g.yas nas g.yon du blta bas bgegs rnams tshar gcad pa dang rjes su gzung ba byas nas rkang mthil a las sna tshogs rdo rjer bltas te khro bo'i 'gying btsal pa lan gsum byas nas rdo rje'i 'gros kyis dbang ldan du song la/

hūm̐ song shig bgegs tshogs ma lus kun// lha dang lha min gsang ba pa// gnod par byed pa'i bgegs tshogs rnams// sgyu 'phrul chen mo'i bdag nyid gtso// bde chen ye shes las byung ba'i// nga ni dpal ldan snying rje'i stobs// bka' yi 'khor lo rab sbyor bas// gal te bka' las 'das gyur na// rdo rje rab tu 'bar ba yis// mgo ni tshal pa brgyar 'gas shing*// zhig par 'gyur ba gdon mi za// de bas gzhan du 'gro bar gyis// zhes lan gsum brjod pas bka' bsgos nas/ sumbha'i sngags drag tu brjod cing*/ rol mo'i sgra dang bcas pas bgegs bskrad nas/ shar du g.yas brkyang*/ lho ru g.yon brkyang*/ nub tu sa ga byang du zlum po la sogs pa'i rkang stabs dang goms stabs kyis dkyil 'khor gyi khor yug kun tu bcags pas rkang rjes rnams sna tshogs rdo rjer gyur par bltas la/ slar yang dbus su 'khod de/ 'dug stongs lag stangs bzhin gyi 'gyur tshul ngag gi 'dren pa rnams ji skad bshad pa'i tshul rnams byas pas kyang byin gyis brlab cing gzung ngo*// sa gzung ba'o// //slar yang bgegs mi 'jug par bya ba'i phyir srung ba'i 'khor lo brtan par dmigs nas sngar bshad pa'i cho gas phyogs mtshams rnams su rdo rje phur bu yang gdab bo// sa gzung ba ste sa'i cho ga'o// de nas lha sta gon la 'jug pa ni phye ma red kyi tshe nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad rnams bsags shing bshams la sngon du 'gro ba'i gtor mas der lhags pa'i 'byung po'i tshogs tshim par byas nas snod du mi rung ba rnams bskrad la las kyi slob mas rnal 'byor la gnas par gsol ba gdab ste yi ge brgya pas rgyud sbyangs nas dkyil 'khor rdzogs par bsgoms la sngags kyi bzlas pa'ang ci rigs par bya'o// de nas mchod rdzas rnams bsang zhing sbyangs nas bskyed cing byin gyis brlabs te/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus su me tog tshom bu bkod la/

sa'i lha mo'i cho ga snga ma ji lta ba bzhin du byas te sa lhag par gnas pa'o// de nas bsgrub pa'i maṇḍal ltar tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor bsgrubs nas mchod pa'i skabs ltar phyi dang*/ nang dang*/ bstod pa dang*/ gtor ma'i bar gyis mchod nas/ pus mo g.yas pa'i lha nga sa la btsugs nas rdo rje dril bu spos dang bcas pa 'dzin pas/ he ru ka dpal bcom ldan 'das// sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro yang dag ldan// phyogs bzhi'i mkha' 'gro ma rnams dang*// rig pa'i lha mo rdzu 'phrul can// byang chub sems dpa' la sogs kun// thams cad bdag la dgongs su gsol// slob ma rnams la phan phyir dang*/ khyed rnams la yang mchod pa'i phyir// bdag gis sdig pa 'jig byed pa'i// dkyil 'khor nang par 'dri 'tshal te// rjes su brtse bas dgongs nas ni// byin gyis brlab par mdzad du gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab pas gnang ba byin par bsam mo// lha lhag par gnas pa'o// de nas bum pa bsang zhing sbyangs nas padma dang zla ba'i steng du bhrūm̐ las rin po che'i bum pa yangs shing rgya che ba lha'i gos kyi mgul chings dang dpag bsam gyi shing gi kha rgyan dang bcas pa drug gam gnyis bshams la/ rnam rgyal gyi bum par mngon byang las gtso bo dang bum pa gzhan bzhir 'khor rnams mngal nas 'byin pa'i tshul gyis bskyed pa'am/ yang na de nyid du thams cad bskyed do// las thams cad pa'i bum par hūm̐ las bdud rtsi 'khyil pa/ khro bo phyag gnyis pa/ sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa dmigs la/ thams cad la rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas gdab pa'i bar du bya ste/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la ni don yod grub pas dbur brgyan pa'o// de nas mchod cing bstod nas/ de dag gi rgyud bskul ba'i phyir rang gi snying ga nas sngags kyi phreng ba gzungs thag la brten nas song ba lha rnams kyi thugs kar phog pas dgyes shing dbang du gyur pas kha dog dmar por gyur nas/

sku'i cha thams cad las ye shes kyi bdud rtsi bab pas bum pa gang bar bsam zhing lha lnga'i sngags sgrub thabs bzhin dang*/ bdud rtsi 'khyil pa la/ oṃ badzra a mṛ ta kuṇḍa li ha na ha na hūm̐ hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces ci rigs pa bzlas nas slar yang mchod cing bstod de dung chos kyi chu blugs pas thams cad 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i bdud rtsi'i chur blta'o// bum pa lhag par gnas pa'o// gzhan yang slob ma la nye bar mkho ba'i yo byad kun yi ge gsum las grub pa'i rdzas dwangs shing thogs pa med par bskyed nas/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ gis byin gyis brlab bo// yo byad lhag par gnas pa'o// de nas bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor mchod pa'i phyir/ tshogs kyi 'khor lo la longs spyad nas lhag ma'i gtor ma byas la gsang ba'i rdzas dang lha rnams mi mngon par bya ba ni bar skabs kyi bya ba'o// //de nas kha dang gdong dag par bkrus pa'i slob ma rnams phyag 'tshal zhing maṇḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas te 'khod pa rnams la/ sngags kyi dngos grub don gnyer gang*// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni gzhug bya ste// bsod nams 'dod pas 'di las gzhan// bdag gzhan 'jig rten pha rol gnyer// dad pa chen po ldan pa dag /'jig rten pha rol la dmigs nas// blo ldan dkyil 'khor gzhug bya ste// 'di yi 'bras bu gnyer mi bya// gal te 'di 'bras don gnyer na// 'jig rten pha rol 'grub mi 'gyur// 'jig rten pha rol la dmigs na// 'bad pa med par 'di 'bras 'grub// ces brjod nas don bshad de/ snying rje chen po las byung ba'i byang chub kyi sems kyis dbang don du gnyer ba'i yid dang ldan par byas pa rnams 'od kyi tshul gyis slob dpon gyi zhal du zhugs pa thugs ka'i ye shes kyi mes sbyangs te yum gyi mkhar byang chub kyi sems kyi rnam par babs pa he ru kar gyur pa las ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas te dbang bskur zhing rigs bdag gi rgyas gdab pa spros nas so so'i gnas su dgod do// de ltar nang gi dbang gis sbyangs pa'i slob ma rnams kyis gong du phul ba'i maṇḍal dbang gi yon du dmigs la/

dga' chen khyod bdag ston pa bas// slob dpon khyod ni dgongs su gsol// byang chub chen po'i tshul bstan pa// mgon po chen po bdag 'tshal lo// dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// byang chub sems kyang bdag la stsol// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// skyabs gsum dag kyang bdag la stsol// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum du khyad par can gyi don zhu ba'i phyir gsol ba 'debs pa rnams la/ bu tshur theg pa chen po la// khyod ni tshul chen snod yin te// gsang sngags spyod tshul cho ga ni// khyod la yang dag bstan par bya// sangs rgyas dus gsum las 'das pa// sku gsung thugs kyi rdo rje can// mnyam nyid ye shes thob pa ni// rdo rje sngags rab bsgoms pas so// gsang sngags spyod pa mnyam med de// he ru ka dpal sbyor ba yis// bdud sde shin tu mi bzad pa'i// dpung chen dag kyang de yis bcom// de bas kun mkhyen thob bya'i phyir// bu yis blo gros 'di gyis shig /ces brjod nas don bshad pas gsang sngags la spro ba bskyed par bya'o// de nas rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i byang chub kyi sems dang sdom pa gzung ba'i phyir/ bdag gi sdig pa bgyis pa dang*// bgyid du stsal dang yi rang ba// sangs rgyas spyan sngar bdag gis ni// ma lus so sor bshags par bgyi// sangs rgyas byang chub sems dpa' dang*// rang rgyal dgra bcom 'gro rnams kyi// tshogs la bdag ni yi rang ngo*// sgyu 'phrul gtso bo yab yum dang*// mkha' 'gro ma dang bcas pa dang*// chos mchog la yang skyabs su mchi// dus gsum bde gshegs thams cad dang*// byang chub sems dpa' thams cad kyis// byang chub sems mchog bskyed pa ltar// de bzhin bdag gis sems bskyed do// ma lus bzhugs pa 'gro ba'i mgon// bde gshegs bla med sangs rgyas rnams// bdag la gzigs nas dgongs su gsol// bdag gis 'di nyid nas bzung nas// sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// bla na med pa'i dkon mchog gsum// sangs rgyas rnal 'byor sdom pa ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// rdo rje rigs mchog chen po la// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar bgyi// rin chen rigs mchog chen po yi// dam tshig yid du 'ong ba la// nyin re zhing ni lan drug tu// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// byang chub chen po las byung ba'i// padma'i rigs mchog dag pa la// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos kyang gzung bar bgyi// las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// yang dag nyid du gzung bar bgyi// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus bgyi// tshul khrims kyi ni bslab pa dang*// dge ba'i chos ni sdud pa dang*// sems can don byed tshul khrims gsum// bdag gis brtan por gzung bar bgyi// gnyis su med pa'i tshangs spyod dang*// rang gi dam tshig bsrung bar bgyi// bdag gi dge ba'i las rnams kyis// sangs rgyas myur du bsgrub bya ste// sems can 'khor ba'i rgya mtsho las// bla med gnas su bsgral bar bgyi// zhes lan gsum brjod du gzhug go

/yang na sta gon gyi skabs su rgyun bshags sngon du 'gro ba'i sems bskyed tsam byas nas/ sdom pa gzung ba rgyas par dngos gzhi'i skabs su mdzad de 'di ni mdzes par mthong ngo*// de nas las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus slob ma'i gnas gsum du thig le bya zhing yi ge gsum las byung ba'i 'khor lo dang*/ padma dang*/ rdo rje/ sa bon so sos mtshan pa bskyed nas de las 'phros pa'i 'od kyis sangs rgyas rnams kyi sku gsung thugs mtshan ma'i rnam pa spyan drangs pa bstim pas rgyas btab cing byin gyis brlabs nas mchod pa'i gnas su gyur pa la me tog la sogs pas mchod do// de nas skal ba dang dngos grub kyi ltas brtag pa'i phyir/ ba byung lnga dang dri bzang pos khye ma med par byugs par me tog gi tshom bu gcig bkod de/ sor bcu gnyis kyi tshad dang ldan pa'i so shing*/ oṃ dzi hā/ badzra saṃ bardha ni'i sngags kyis byin pa thal mo sbyar bas blangs nas/ so'i dri ma bsal nas 'chos la sdig pa thams cad skyug pa'i bsam pas kha shar ram byang du bltas te/ 'dor du bcug pa'i rtse mo shar du phyogs na zhi ba/ lhor mngon spyod/ nub tu dbang*/ byang du rgyas pa/ steng du mkha' spyod/ 'og tu gter/ mtshams su dngos grub phra mo/ bdag nyid la phyogs na mchog gi dngos grub 'grub par lung bstan to// //de nas las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus skyor chu sbyin zhing*/ oṃ hrīḥbi shuddha sarba dharmā ssarba pā paṃ ni tsa sya saṃ sho dha ya sarba bi kalpa na ā pa na ya hūm̐ phaṭa/ ces brjod de 'thung du bcug pas nang gi dri ma sbyang ngo*// de nas rdo rje'i mdud pa gsum dang ldan pa'i srung skud byin gyis brlabs pa skyes pa'i dpung pa g.yon pa dang*/ bud med kyi g.yas par bcings nas/ 'jig rten du ni kun mkhyen dag /u dumbā ra'i me tog ltar// brgya lam na ni res 'ga' zhig /'byung 'gyur yang ni mi 'byung ngo*// sngags kyi spyod pa'i tshul 'di ni// de bas kyang ni rnyed dka' ste// gang gis mnyam med sems can don// bla na med pa byed par nus// gnyis med zab mo'i spyod tshul 'di// sems can sangs rgyas thob byed pa'o// dang po bskal pa grangs med nas// bsags pa'i sdig pa gang dang gang*// de kun zad par 'gyur ba ni// zab mo'i dkyil 'khor mthong bas so// zhes brjod pa'i don bshad la spro ba mi nyams par bya'o// de nas yi ge gsum gyis mngon par bsngags pa'i ku shadhīḥdang has lag pa g.yas dang g.yon du byin pa sngas dang stan du bcug nas gzhogs g.yas pa 'og tu phab ste rnam par rtog pa spangs nas lha dang bla ma yid la dran bzhin pas nyal du bcug la rmi lam mthong ba nang par smros shig ces bsgos nas btang la nang par rmi lam brjod pa'i tshe bgegs dang ldan par rig na drag po'i sbyin sreg gam khro bo'i sngags dang rnal 'byor gyis sbyang ba dang sdig pa dang bar chad dang ldan pa la zhi ba'i sbyin sreg gam spyan gyi rnal 'byor gyis sbyang zhing bzang po mthong na spro ba bskyed do// slob ma lhag par gnas pa'o// de nas slob ma rnams rang gi gnas su dong ba'i mthar/

tshom bu'i dkyil 'khor la mchod cing bstod nas/ badzro tiṣṭha'i sngags dang phyag rgyas nam mkha' la bteg ste de nyid du bzhugs su gsol nas mgron gshegs su gsol te gtor ma btang la/ rang gi gnas gsum bsrungs nas nyal ba'i rnal 'byor gyis gnas par bya'o// nang par ldang ba'i rnal 'byor gyis ldang ngo*// lhag par gnas pa sta gon gyi cho ga'o// de nas tho rangs kyi cha la man ngag bzhin brkyang ba dang bskor ba'i las kyi thig gis cha rnam par phye nas ji ltar 'byor pa'i rdul tshon drang ba bde zhing kha dog bzang ba bsgrubs pa rnams kyi dkar po la oṃ bris la/ dkyil 'khor gyi dbus dang*/ sngon po la hūm̐/ ser po la trām̐/ dmar po la hrīḥ ljang gu la āḥbris pa rnams shar nas rim pa bzhin bkod la thig skud sboms su sgo'i nyi shu cha/ chur dkyil 'khor gyi nyis 'gyur gyi tshad dang ldan pa so so'ang lnga sgril du bya zhing*/ 'jur mdud dang sbom phra dang ring thung gi nyes pa dang bral ba kha dog lngas bsgyur ba rnams tshon so so'i steng du bzhag pa'i khor yug tu mchod pa dang gtor ma bshams nas rang gi rnal 'byor sngon du 'gro bas bsang zhing sbyangs pa'i ngang las sa bon so so las rigs lnga yab yum du bskyed pa la/ gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas 'bar ba'i lta bas ye shes pa spyan drangs pa bstim zhing dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas btab la/ gtor ma'i bar gyis mchod nas snyoms par zhugs te bde ba chen po'i mes 'od du zhu ba las byung ba'i thig tshon du bskyed nas mtheb srin gyis mnye zhing*/ oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes yang yang brjod do// de nas rang nyid he ru ka dang*/ las kyi slob ma sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma'i nga rgyal dang ldan pas nub dang shar du langs la gnyis kas dza zhes brjod cing slob dpon gyis thig sna gtad pa slob mas blangs nas chos thams cad ro gcig par bsam zhing*/

oṃ a n+yo n+ya a nu ga ta/ sarba dharmā spa ra spa ra a nu ga ta/ sarba dharmā a tyanta a nu ga ta/ sarba dharmā a tyanta a nu pra be sha ya sarba dharmā hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing bsgril ba rdo rje'i lte ba la dkris la bdud rtsi gtor nas slar yang brkyang ba slob mas bzung ste lag pa g.yas pa'i mtheb srin gyis steng nas 'og dang 'og nas steng du nam mkha' la thig dang po gdab bo// de nas g.yas skor gyis lho nas byang dang me nas dbang ldan dang*/ rlung nas bden bral dang*/ de nyid nas dbang ldan dang*/ me nas srin po dang*/ me nas rlung dang*/ bden bral nas dbang ldan du gnas pas snga ma bzhin gdab cing*/ nam mkha' gang ba'i de bzhin gshegs// 'gro don mdzad dus 'di lags pas// khyed rnams 'dir ni gshegs gsol bar// thig skud sgra yis bskul bar bgyi// oṃ badzra sa ma ya sū tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing btab pas thig gi rjes de dag nyid dkyil 'khor gyi rnam par grub par dmigs la/ oṃ badzra be gā kra ma ho'i sngags dang phyag rgyas dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la bteg nas/ slob dpon rdo rje dril bu 'dzin pas dbus su song la hi/ zhes brjod cing phyogs bzhir bltas pas sgo zhi dbye bar bsams nas/ dbang ldan gyi rtsig pa nang nas rim pa bzhin dkar po/ ljang gu/ dmar po/ ser po/ sngon po rnams g.yon pa'i rdo rje khu tshur gyis g.yas skor du bri zhing*/ chos dbyings 'di ni rnam par dag /sems can khams ni rab sgrol byed// sgyu 'phrul zhes bya'i rgyal po che'i// tshon gyi las ni yang dag brtsam// oṃ badzra sa ma ya tsi tra ma ti kra ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing 'dres pa dang*/ sbom phra dang*/ yo ba dang chad pa la sogs pa'i skyon med par bri bar bya'o// de nas hūm̐ gi sngags kyis dbus kyi phur pa dbyung zhing*/ rtsig pa'i rim pa ltar tshon rtsi rnams bkye nas lhag ma slob ma rnams kyis 'drir gzhug go

/de'ang dkyil 'khor gyi rnam pa ni kye'i rdo rje la sogs pa dang 'dra la/ lha snam ni shar sngo/ lho ser/ nub dmar/ byang ljang ba'o// dbus padma 'dab ma brgyad pa mu khyud rdo rje'i phreng bas bskor ba'i lte bar rdo rjes mtshan pa'i kha ṭwāṃ ga dang*/ shar nas rim pas rdo rje/ rin po che/ padma/ ral gri dang*/ mtshams bzhir ka pā la bzhis mdzes par bya'o// de'i khor yug tu chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa dang*/ gtor ma rnams dang*/ rgyan dang lhab lhub thams cad kyis brgyan par bya'o// dkyil 'khor gyi las so// de nas phyi ma red kyi tshe bzlas pa'i bar sta gon bzhin byas nas mchod rdzas rnams byin gyis brlabs te dkyil 'khor bsang zhing sbyangs pa'i ngang las srung 'khor dur khrod brgyad dang bcas pa'i rten gyi dkyil 'khor sgrub thabs ltar bskyed nas/ brten pa lha rnams ni slob dpon he ru ka yab yum gyi nga rgyal gyis gsang gnas nas 'byin pa'i tshul gyis spros la skye mched dang sku gsung thugs byin gyis brlabs nas sta gon gyi dkyil 'khor nam mkha' la gnas pa la mchod cing bstod de bstim la bdag bskyed kyi dkyil 'khor dang yang gnyis su med par byas te slar yang thugs ka'i sa bon gyi 'od kyis dam tshig gi dkyil 'khor ji lta ba'i ye shes pa sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' ma lus pas bskor ba'ang spyan drangs la mchod pa dang bstod pas mnyes par byas nas ro gcig par byas te/ dbang bskur gyi lha spyan drangs nas mchod cing bstod de gsol ba btab pas dbang bskur nas rigs kyi bdag po'i rgyas btab la dbang gi lha de dag dang yang gnyis su med par bya'o// de nas dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo las rdo rje slob dpon gtso bo 'ba' zhig gi rnam pas bye bas shar phyogs su gnas nas lha so so'i mtshan sngon du 'gro ba'i yi ge brgya pa brjod pas byin gyis brlab cing brtan par bya'o// dkyil 'khor bsgrub pa'o// de nas chu gnyis sngon du 'gro ba'i mchod pa lnga gos zung dang bcas pa dang*/

nang gi mchod pa dang*/ bstod pa rnams kyis mchod nas gtor ma dang po 'di nyid kyi cho gas dpal he ru ka dang*/ gnyis pa chos skyong dang*/ gsum pa zhing skyong rnams la 'bul lo// grub na zhi ba'am rgyas pa'i sbyin sreg gis kyang mchod par bya'o// mchod pa'o// de nas slob ma la ji ltar bya ba bzhin slob dpon bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blangs te nang du 'jug pa'i tshe sgo dbye ba'i phyag rgya bcas la/ oṃ badzrod gha ṭa sa ma ya pra be sha ya hūm̐/ zhes brjod pas sgo phye la 'jug go /dbang blangs pa'i mthar slob ma thogs pa med par 'jug pa'i phyir/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu byung*// de bzhin de nyid nges par 'byung*// bden pa de yis dkyil 'khor ni// gzugs brnyan gsal bar slob ma rnams// kun gyis dri med mthong bar shog /ces bden pa'i stobs lan gsum brjod do// bdag nyid 'jug cing dbang blang ba'o// de nas bdag nyid mchod pa sta gon bzhin byas nas/ dkyil 'khor yol bas bsgribs la khrus byas pa'i slob ma phyag 'tshal nas 'khod pa rnams gzhug cing dbang bskur ba ni/ maṇḍal phul nas snyim pa me tog dang bcas pas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rang bzhin sku// slob dpon mgon la skyabs su mchi// gtso bo mkha' 'gro mar bcas pa'i// lha rnams kun la phyag 'tshal lo// thar pa chen po'i grong mchog tu// mgon po bdag ni gzhug tu gsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba 'debs su bcug nas/ bla mas dkyil 'khor gyi lha la/ de bzhin gshegs pa kun gyi gnas// he ru ka dpal grong khyer mchog /snying po'i dkyil 'khor 'di ru ni// bdag gi slob ma gzhug par bgyi// zhes lan gsum gyis gsol ba gdab bo// de nas bdud rtsi 'khyil pa'i sngags brjod cing las thams cad pa'i bum pa'i chus bsangs nas bdud rtsi lce la gtor zhing*/

oṃ āḥhūm̐ zhes brjod nas byin gyis brlabs la/ a khaṃ bī ra hūm̐ gi sngags kyis gdong g.yogs bcings me tog gi phreng ba'ang gtad do// de nas slob dpon gyis bu khyod su yin zhes dri/ slob mas skal bzang bdag ces lan gdab/ yang ci la dga'/ bde ba chen po la'o// zhes pa dang*/ de yis bu la ci zhig bya dang*/ sangs rgyas mchog gi dam tshig go zhes dris pa dang*/ lan gyis rigs nges par rtogs par byas nas/ slob dpon dang slob ma gnyis kas slob ma'i snying gi nang du kun rdzob byang chub sems kyi ngo bo zla ba'i dkyil 'khor la gnas pa'i don dam byang chub sems kyi ngo bo rdo rje dkar po rtse lnga pas nang gi mun pa sel bar bsams nas snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ oṃ sarba yo ga tsitta utpā da yā mi su ra ti sa ma ya st+waṃ ho/ siddhe badzra ya thā su khaṃ/ zhes brjod nas byang chub kyi sems bskyed la spyi bor rdo rje bzhag nas/ deng khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyi rigs su zhugs kyis/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi gsang chen dam pa 'di de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dkyil 'khor du ma zhugs pa rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ ma dad pa rnams la yang ma yin no// zhes gsang bar gdams nas gtso bo'i thugs ka nas sgo ma bzhi'i phyag mtshan thogs pa'i mkha' 'gro ma bzhi 'phros pas slob ma rnams dkyil 'khor gyi shar sgor bcug par bsam zhing*/ dzaḥhūm̐ bam̐ hoḥ zhes brjod la yol ba'i nang du gzhug pa'am yol ba dbye bar bya'o// de nas na maste hūm̐/ na mo mi hūm̐/ na mo nā ma hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing sku gsung thugs kyi phyag gsum 'tshal nas shar phyogs su 'gro ba'am/ phyin par mos la/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma'i nga rgyal gyis byin gyi brlab tu gsol ba'i yid kyis snying gar thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ badzra ḍā ki nī ye pū dza u pasthā nā ya ātma naṃ nirya ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta a kṣo bhya/

a dhi tiṣṭa swa māṃ/ zhes brjod nas phyag 'tshal du gzhug go /de nas lho phyogs nas rin chen mkha' 'gro ma'i nga rgyal gyis dbang bskur bar gsol ba'i yid kyis dpral bar thal mo sbyar la/ oṃ ratna ḍā ki nī ye pū dza a bhi ṣe kā ya ātma naṃ nirya ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta ratna sambha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa tu māṃ/ zhes brjod cing phyag 'tshal lo// de nas nub phyogs nas padma mkha' 'gro ma'i nga rgyal gyis chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar gsol ba'i yid kyis mgrin par thal mo sbyar nas/ oṃ padma ḍā ki nī ye pū dza pra warta na ya ātma naṃ nirya ta yā mi/ sarba ta thā ga ta a mi tā bha ba dharma tsakra pra warta nā ya māṃ/ zhes brjod cing phyag 'tshal/ de nas byang gi phyogs nas sna tshogs mkha' 'gro ma'i nga rgyal gyis phrin las bsgrub par gsol ba'i yid kyis spyi bor thal mo sbyar nas/ oṃ bi shwa ḍā ki nī ye pū dza karma ne ya ātma naṃ nirya ta yā mi sarba ta thā ga ta a mo gha siddhi karma ku ru māṃ/ zhes brjod nas phyag 'tshal du bcug la slar yang dkyil 'khor gyi shar phyogs su 'khod cing maṇḍal phul nas/ dam tshig de nyid bdag la stsol// bdag la sdom pa rnams kyang stsol// byang chub mchog tu sems bskyed pa// slob dpon chen po bdag la stsol// zhes lan gsum du gsol ba btab nas/ sangs rgyas chos dang dge 'dun te// dkon mchog sum la skyabs su song*// 'di ni sangs rgyas rigs dag pa'i// sdom pa brtan por gyur pa'o// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya rnams// blo chen khyod kyis gzung bar gyis// byang chub sems gang de rdo rje// shes rab dril bu zhes brjod do// bla ma sangs rgyas kun mnyam pa// slob dpon dag kyang gzung bar gyis// 'di ni rdo rje'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig sdom pa yin par brjod// rin chen rigs la rtag tu ni// nyin dang mtshan mo lan gsum du// zang zing mi 'jigs chos dang byams// sbyin pa rnam bzhi rtag tu sbyin// phyi nang gsang ba theg pa gsum// dam pa'i chos kyang ma lus gzung*// 'di ni padma'i rigs dag pa'i// dam tshig dang ni sdom pa'i mchog

/las kyi rigs mchog chen po la// sdom pa thams cad ldan par ni// khyod kyis yang dag gzung bar gyis// mchod pa'i las kyang ci nus byos// zhes brjod pas sdom pa bsgrags la/ de rnams rjes su gzung ba'i bsam pas sta gon gyi skabs su bshad pa ltar/ rigs thams cad kyi sdom pa gzung ba lan gsum rjes su brjod pas sdom pa 'dzin du gzhug go /de ltar thob pa'i dam tshig mi nyams par bsrung bar gdams pa'i phyir spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ ye shes gang gis khyod de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyi dngos grub thob par 'gyur na dngos grub gzhan lta smos kyang ci dgos/ de lta bu'i rdo rje ye shes bskyed par bya'i/ khyod kyis dkyil 'khor chen po ma mthong ba rnams kyi mdun du smra bar mi bya ste/ bu khyod dam tshig nyams par 'gyur ta re zhes phan yon gyi sgo nas dang*/ yang snying gar rdo rje bzhag la/ he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// snying la yang dag zhugs par gyur// gal te tshul 'di smras na ni// de ma thag tu dral te gshegs// zhes brjod nas spyi bor bzhag la/ 'di ni khyod kyi dam tshig gi rdo rje ste/ gal te tshul 'di su yang rung ba la smras na 'dis khyod kyi mgo 'gas par 'gyur ro// zhes nyes dmigs dang*/ de nas khyor chu sbyin zhing*/ 'di ni khyod kyi dmyal ba'i chu// dam tshig 'das na sreg par byed// dam tshig bsrungs na dngos grub ni// rdo rje bdud rtsi'i chu 'dis 'grub// oṃ badzra u da ka oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes gnyis ka dang*/ spyi bor rdo rje bzhag la/ deng nas brtsams te bu khyod kyi dpal he ru ka nga yin gyi/ ngas bsgo ba de khyod kyis gyis shig khyod kyis nga la brnyas pa byas na mi bde ba ma spangs par 'chi ba'i dus byas nas dmyal bar ltung bar 'gyur ta re zhes bla ma'i bka' mnyan par bsgo ba ste/ rnam pa bzhis dam la bzhag go /de nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// bdag la byin gyis rlob mdzod la// rdo rje ye shes bla med pa// da lta nyid du dbab tu gsol// zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs pa'i slob ma la/

phyi nang gi chos thams cad sgyu ma ltar shes pas zhen pa dang bral ba'i yid bskyed nas/ gnyis kas slob ma he ru ka'i rnam pas langs te gnas pa'i 'og gi gzhi rlung gi dkyil 'khor/ rkang mthil rlung*/ sum mdo me/ lto ba chu/ snying ga sa/ so so'i sa bon gyis mtshan par bsgoms nas snying gi nang du nyi ma la gnas pa'i he ru ka yab yum dmigs te/ gzhi'i rlung gis rkang mthil gyi rlung bskyod cing*/ des sum mdo'i me sbar bas lus thams cad gang bas sdig pa dang rtog pa thams cad bsregs/ lto ba'i chu bskol/ snying ga'i sa bsregs/ 'od kyi snang bas phyogs bcu'i sangs rgyas rnams spyan drangs pa char chen po bab pa ltar lus la thim pas ro gcig tu gyur pas/ snying ga'i he ru ka gar mdzad par bsam zhing*/ zla mtshan dang ldan pa'i 'dom dkris dang*/ byi la'i brun dang sbags pa'i gu gul gyi dud pas bdug rol mo'i sgra drag tu dkrol/ oṃ badzra ā be sha ya a a/ zhes bya ba dang*/ lha lnga'i sngags brjod pas lus dang ngag dang yid la babs pa'i rtags 'byung zhing*/ oṃ tiṣṭha badzra/ zhes brjod nas rdo rje spyi bor rgya gram du bzhag pas de mi nyams shing brtan par bya'o// de nas slob ma la dkyil 'khor bstan cing gzhug pa'i phyir 'di skad ces/ 'di yi bsod nams gang yin pas// lha yi rigs kyi rim pa dang*// 'di yi dngos grub gang yin dang*// rigs ni gang gi snod du gyur// 'di yi bsod nams ji lta bar// dkyil 'khor 'dir ni de bzhin shog /ces bden pa'i stobs brjod nas nam mkha'i kha dog gis dngos grub kyi ltas brtags te/ oṃ pra tītstsha badzra ho/ zhes brjod cing me tog phreng ba dkyil 'khor la dor nas lha'i rigs brtags la/ lha dang bla ma bskul ba'i phyir/ oṃ pra ti grihna st+wa mi maṃ sa twa ma hā ba la/ zhes brjod de spyi bor bzhag la/ mig 'bras gnyis/ oṃ du bskyed la/

he ru ka dpal deng khyod kyi// mig 'byed par ni brtson par mdzad// phye bas thams cad mthong 'gyur ba// rdo rje'i mig ni bla na med// oṃ badzra ne tra a pa ha ra pa ṭa la hrīḥpraṃ/ zhes brjod nas gdong g.yogs phye la/ thar pa chen po'i grong khyer mchog /ltos shig ltos shig sems dpa' che// me tog gang du lhung gyur pa// de ni khyod kyi lhag pa'i lha// dkyil 'khor bzang po 'di la ltos// da ni dad pa rab tu skyed// khyod ni rnal 'byor ma rigs skyes// sngags dang phyag rgyas byin gyis brlabs// 'gro ba'i phun tshogs thams cad dang*// dngos grub kun khyod 'grub par 'gyur// dam tshig thams cad bskyang ba dang*// sngags rnams la yang brtson par gyis// zhes brjod la gtso bo nas srung ba'i 'khor lo'i mthar thug pa'i dkyil 'khor yongs su rdzogs par bstan par bya'o// nang gi 'jug pa ste 'jug pa'i cho ga'o// de nas dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul nas/ he ru ka dpal dbang bskur ba// 'gro ba skyob pa'i gzi brjid can// ji ltar yon tan 'byung gnas gtso// de bzhin bdag la'ang de stsol cig /ces lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug nas padma 'dab brgyad bris pa'i dbang stegs kyi dkyil 'khor rin po che'i khri padma dang nyi ma'i gdan du mos pa'i steng du me tog gang la phog pa'i lha'i rnam pas gnas pa gdugs dang rgyal mtshan dang rnga yab la sogs pa mchod pa'i sprin phung gis bskor ba la/ dkyil 'khor gyi gtso bo'i thugs ka nas 'phros pa'i khro bos bgegs bskrad/ lha mos mchod pas mchod/ byang chub sems dpas shis pa brjod/ rig mas rdo rje'i glu len/ de bzhin gshegs pas khrus gsol bar bsams nas/ dngos su gu gul gyis bdugs la yungs kar gyis brab cing drag po'i sngags dang shis pa dang mchod pa bya'o// sngon du bya ba'o// de nas slob dpon gyi thugs ka nas sngags kyi phreng ba 'phros pas slob ma he ru kar dmigs pa'i snying ga'i hūm̐ gi tha mar bkod par gnyis kas bsgom zhing snying po'i sngags lan gsum rjes su bzlas pa'i mthar/

bcom ldan bdag la stsal lags kyi// bcom ldan bdag la byin gyis rlobs// zhes lan gsum brjod du bcug nas/ slob dpon gyis slob ma'i spyi bor me tog bzhag la/ 'di la zhes 'don pa bsgyur nas/ oṃ dharma kuṇḍa a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod do// de nas rig pa'i dbang lnga bskur ba'i phyir slob ma dang dbang rdzas swa bhā was stong par sbyangs pa'i ngang las padma dang nyi ma'i gdan la so so'i sa bon las byung ba'i phyag mtshan sa bon gyis mtshan pa las 'od 'phros pas so so'i rigs dang 'brel pa'i sems can gyi don byas slar 'dus pas rigs so so'i kha dog dang phyag mtshan yab dang 'dra ba'i yum dang bcas par gyur pa'i skye mched dang gnas gsum byin gyis brlabs nas/ ye shes pa dang ro gcig par byas te/ dbang rdzas la dbang bskur nas rigs bdag gi rgyas btab pa de snyoms par zhugs pa zhu ba las/ dbang rdzas so sor gyur pa sngags dang tshigs su bcad pas sbyin zhing de brtan par bya ba'i phyir bum pa'i chus dbang bskur ro// de dag gi tshe dbang gi lha rnams kyis gong du brjod pa'i las mdzad par gnyis kas bsam zhing*/ rang rang gi rigs bdag gi rgyas btab nas mchod pa rnams kyis mchod la so so'i brda sprad do// de'ang hūm̐ las mi bskyod pa sngon po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa/ rdo rje mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba bskyed nas/ dbang bskur rdo rje chen po la// khams gsum pa yis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas rnams kyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba yang dag sbyin// oṃ badzrī bha ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing chu'i dbang sbyin no// trāṃ las rin chen 'byung ldan ser po rin po che dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum rin chen mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba bskyed nas/ thor tshugs cod paṇa gyis brgyan pa// bde gshegs kun gyis bsngags pa yi// rin chen dbu rgyan dam pa dang*// dar dpyangs dbang bskur sbyin par bya// oṃ badzra ratna mu ku ṭa pa ṭa a ba laṃ ba a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/

zhes brjod cing dbu rgyan gyi dbang sbyin no// hrīḥlas 'od dpag med dmar po padma dang dril bu 'dzin pa padma mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba bskyed nas/ sangs rgyas kun gyi rdo rje'i dbang*// de ring khyod la bskur bar bya// sangs rgyas kun tu rab bsgrub phyir// rdo rje 'di ni khyod kyis zung*// oṃ ma hā badzra a bhi ṣiñtsa hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing rdo rje'i dbang sbyin no// a las don yod grub pa ljang gu sna tshogs rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa las kyi mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba bskyed nas/ 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// shes rab dbyangs kyi rjes 'gror bshad// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// byang chub mchog tu rgyal bas bzhed// oṃ badzra a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ zhes brjod cing dril bu'i dbang sbyin no// oṃ las rnam par snang mdzad dkar po 'khor lo dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba bskyed nas/ oṃ shrī he ru ka a dhi pa ti st+waṃ a bhi ṣiñtsā mi/ shrī he ru ka badzra nā ma a bhi ṣe ka ta/ kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa'o// zhes brjod cing me tog gang la phog pa'i rigs kyi ming gdags te/ skyes pa dang bud med kyi dbye bas mi bskyod rdo rje/ rdo rje sems dpa'/ rol pa'i rdo rje/ rdo rje mā ma kī/ rdo rje snyems ma la sogs pa mi bskyod pa'i rigs kyi ming ngo*// rnam par snang mdzad rdo rje/ rtag pa'i rdo rje/ oṃ mdzad rdo rje/ rdo rje spyan ma la sogs pa rnam par snang mdzad kyi'o// rin chen rdo rje/ nam mkha'i rdo rje/ gzi brjid rdo rje/ rdo rje phreng ba ma la sogs pa rin chen 'byung ldan gyi'o// 'od dpag med rdo rje/ padma'i rdo rje/ chos kyi rdo rje/ rdo rje gos dkar mo la sogs pa 'od dpag med kyi'o// don yod rdo rje/

las kyi rdo rje/ dam tshig rdo rje/ rdo rje sgrol ma la sogs pa don yod grub pa'i rigs kyi ming ngo*// de ltar rig pa'i rgyal po de bzhin gshegs pa lnga'i dbang bskur bas phung po lnga dang*/ nyon mongs pa lnga sbyangs nas rigs lnga dang ye shes lnga'i go 'phang thob par byas zhes rtogs pa bskyed do// de nas hūm̐ las rdo rje sems dpa' dkar po rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba bskyed nas/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad de// rdo rje sems dpa'i phyag na gnas// khyod kyis kyang ni rtag tu zung*// rdo rje sems dpa'i brtul zhugs brtan// oṃ sarba ta thā ga ta siddhi badzra sa ma ya st+waṃ e ṣa dha ra yā mi hi hi hi hi hūm̐/ zhes brjod cing*/ rdo rje byin pa snying gar bzung nas/ snying gi nang du yang rdo rje sems dpa' gnyis kas mos pa ni rdo rje'i brtul zhugs te slob ma'i dbang ngo*// de nas rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul nas/ dpa' bo chen pos mi ldog pa'i// dbang bskur ba ni bdag la stsol// 'gro ba mtshan ma med byed pa// de ni deng 'dir mdzad du gsol// sems can kun gyi don gyi phyir// bdag ni rdo rje slob dpon gyur// zhes lan gsum gsol ba btab nas slob ma dbang stegs kyi steng du gnas pa hūm̐ las rdo rje 'chang chen po sngon po phyag gnyis kyis rdo rje dang dril bu 'dzin pa yum rdo rje snyems ma dang mnyam par sbyor ba bskyed nas/ dbang gi lhas dbang bskur ba'i bar snga ma ltar bsgom zhing*/ 'di de sangs rgyas thams cad nas// sngags kyi bar brjod pas rdo rje byin la/ thog mtha' med pa'i sems dpa' ni// rdo rje sems dpa' dga' ba che// kun tu bzang po kun bdag nyid// rdo rje snyems ma'i bdag po'i bdag /bcom ldan 'das dpal mchog dang po'i skyes bu'o// ma hā badzra hūm̐/

zhes de kho na nyid brjod nas/ 'di ni rnal 'byor ma la sogs pa dang*/ aḥzhes brjod nas dril bu gtad la/ srid pa ngo bo nyid kyis dag /ngo bo nyid kyis srid bral byas// rang bzhin dag pa'i sems ldan pa// srid pa dam par rgyal bas bzhed// oṃ badzra ghaṇḍe aḥ zhes de kho na nyid brjod/ de nas yum dang mnyam par sbyor ba'i sku la yid gtad nas/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad kyis// 'da' ba ru ni mi mdzad pa'i// dam tshig phyag rgya zhes su bshad// yid kyi lus ni brtan phyir ro// zhes pa dang*/ rdo rje che dang dril bu che// zung shig rdo rjer byin gyis brlabs// de ring rdo rje slob dpon gyur// slob ma'i tshogs rnams bsdu bar gyis// zhes dam tshig gsum byin nas bum pa'i chus kyang dbang bskur la/ rdo rje sems dpa' dbur brgyan nas/ oṃ su pra tiṣṭha badzra ye swā hā/ zhes brjod de/ me tog gtor la dkyil 'khor pa dang bcas pa thams cad kyis khams gsum chos kyi rgyal por rab tu gnas par byas par gnyis kas bsam mo// rdo rje slob dpon gyi dbang ngo*// de nas rten gyi dkyil 'khor byang chub kyi phyogs kyi chos sum cu rtsa bdun la sogs pa lam gyi chos mtshon par byed pa yin la lha rnams ni phung po dang*/ 'byung ba dang*/ nyon mongs pa la sogs pa 'khor ba'i chos rnam par dag pa ye shes dang yon tan dang phrin las la sogs pa 'bras bu'i chos mtshon par byed cing de thams cad kyang rdo rje slob dpon gyi sku dang thugs la gnyis su med par tshang ngo*// zhes dkyil 'khor dang*/ lha dang*/ rdo rje slob dpon gyi de kho na nyid brjod do// de nas rdul tshon gyis bsgos pa'i gser gyi thur ma la sogs pas mig dbye ba'i tshul du bya zhing*/ ji ltar mig mkhan rgyal po yis// 'jig rten ling tog bsal ba ltar// bu khyod kyi ni mi shes pa'i// rab rib rgyal ba rnams kyis bsal// oṃ badzra nai tra a pa ha ra pa ka la hrī praṃ/

zhes mi shes pa'i rab rib bsal nas chos kyi mig dri ma med pa thob par gyis/ zhes bsgo'o// de nas me long dag par shar ba'i gzugs brnyan bltar bcug nas/ chos rnams gzugs brnyan lta bu ste// gsal zhing dag la rnyog pa med// gzung du med cing brjod du med// rgyu dang las las kun tu 'byung*// ngo bo nyid med gnas med pa// de ltar chos rnams shes gyis la// sems can don kun mnyam med byos// 'on kyang skyob pa'i sras su skye// zhes brjod nas yul gzugs brnyan dang byed pa sgyu ma'i tshul du shes par gyis shig ces bsgo'o// de nas mda' gzhu gtad pa phyogs drug tu 'phen pa'i tshul byed du gzhug cing*/ ho de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad dang lhan cig rjes su chags par byos shig ces brjod nas/ bdag la chags pa dang gzhan la 'tshe ba/ theg pa chen po la rgyab kyis phyogs pa'i sems gzhom par gyis shig ces bsgo ba rnams sems can gyi don gyi rjes sug nang ba'o// de nas lag tu 'khor lo byin la/ deng nas bzung ste 'jig rten la// chos kyi 'khor lo bla med pa// kun tu dri med sdig med pa// skyob pa rnams kyis 'khor lo skor// zhes chos kyi 'khor lo bskor bar bsgos nas/ dung 'bud du bcug la/ khyod kyis the tshom dogs med par// yid gnyis med pa'i sems kyis ni// chos kyi dung ni bla med pa// dri med kun tu gang bar gyis// zhes chos kyi dung 'bud par bsgo ba ni/ chos 'chang pa'i rjes su gnang ba'o// de nas sna tshogs rdo rje lag tu byin la/ zhi dang rgyas dang dbang dang dgug /sdang bar byed dang gnod sogs dang*// bskrad dang gsad pa de bzhin te// las de dag ni bsgrub par gyis// zhes gzhan don du las de dag bsgrub par bsgo ba ni phrin las kyi rjes su gnang ba'o// de nas slob dpon shākya thub pa'i nga rgyal 'dzin pas snam sbyar gyon nas/

mi 'jigs pa sbyin pa'i phyag rgya slob ma'i spyi bor bzhag nas/ 'dir ni khyod la ngas lung bstan// he ru ka dpal de bzhin gshegs// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i ngan 'gro las khyod bton// kye dpal che ge mo rdo rje zhes bya ba'i de bzhin gshegs pa siddhi sa ma ya st+waṃ bhurbhu wa swaḥgang la ngas lung bstan pa bzhin sangs rgyas dang byang chub sems dpa' rnams dang*/ dpa' bo dang rnal 'byor ma thams cad kyis mgrin gcig tu lung ston par mdzad do// zhes brjod nas rtogs pa bskyed de lung bstan pa'o// de nas slob dpon brnyas par mi bya zhing*// gus pa yis ni mchod par bya// rdo rje dril bu phyag rgya yang*// yongs su gtad par mi bya'o// dam tshig sdom pa bsrung bya ste// rnam par rtog med gos med par// rang lha'i rnal 'byor gnas pa yis// 'dod pa'i yon tan bsten par bya// khyod ni sangs rgyas rigs su skyes// dngos grub thams cad grub par 'gyur// zhes brjod pa ni dbugs dbyung ba'o// de nas/ mchog tu gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor 'dir// btsud pa dang ni mthong ba yis// de ring sdig las rnam grol te// de ring khyed rnams bde bar gnas// bde chen theg pa 'di la ni// phyis ni 'chi ba yod ma yin// srid pa shin tu dag pas na// srid pa'i sdug bsngal rnams las grol// zhes brjod pa ni gzengs bstod pa'o// de ltar rdul tshon gyi dkyil 'khor du bum pa'i dbang thob/ lus kyi dri ma dag bskyed pa'i rim pa dbyibs bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu sprul pa'i sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ zhes brda sprad do// bum pa'i dbang ngo*// //de nas gsang ba'i dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul nas/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur rab gsang ba// gtso bo chen pos bdag la stsol// zhes gsol ba lan gsum 'debs su bcug nas/ gdong g.yogs bcing la yig 'bru gsum brjod cing bdud rtsi gtor nas slob dpon dpal he ru ka dngos sam ye shes kyi rig ma sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mar dmigs la/

gnyis ka'i gnas lnga dang*/ mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas/ yum gyis/ kye ho gnyen mchog la sogs pa'i glus bskul ba dang*/ bde ba myong zhing slob ma la dbang sbyin pa'i 'dun pas snyoms par zhugs pa'i sgras/ de bzhin gshegs pa thams cad bskul zhal du zhugs snying gar 'od du zhu/ byang chub kyi sems rdo rje nor bur gnas pa'i bde ba chen pos phyi nang gi lha rnams mchod nas phaṭa ces brjod pas phyung la/ gsang ba'i dbang bskur chen po ni// khams gsum kun gyis phyag byas pa// sangs rgyas kun gyi gsang gsum gyi// gnas las byung ba yang dag sbyin// oṃ āḥhūm̐/ zhes brjod pas slob ma'i khar sbyin zhing*/ nam mkha' gang ba'i dbang gi lha thams cad kyis bkra shis dang*/ mchod pa mdzad par bsam mo// slob mas kyang mid nas lus thams cad gang bas ngag gi dri ma sbyangs nas 'od dpag tu med par bsgoms la/ a ho ma hā su kha/ zhes brjod du gzhug go /de nas gdong g.yogs phye nas gsang ba'i dkyil 'khor du gsang ba bdud rtsi'i dbang thob/ ngag gi dri ma dag zab pa sngags kyi lam bsgom pa la dbang*/ 'bras bu longs sku'i rten 'brel mngon du byas/ zhes brda sprad do// gsang ba'i dbang ngo*// //de nas shes rab ye shes kyi dbang gi don du maṇḍal phul nas/ slob dpon go 'phang che rang bzhin// skal ba chen po bdag la stsol// bde gshegs rnams kyi dbang bskur ni// sangs rgyas byang chub rab bsgrub pa// brtul zhugs mchog ni khyod drin gyis// bdag la nges par stsal lags kyi// des ni sems can dpag med don// ji ltar 'bul bzhin bdag bgyid do// zhes lan gsum gsol ba 'debs su bcug nas snga ma ltar gdong g.yogs bcing zhing bdud rtsi gtor la/ gnyis kas slob ma he ru kar bskyed nas dngos sam ye shes kyi rig ma sangs rgyas mkha' 'gro mar bskyed nas/ mdzes ma 'di ni gzung ba dang*// bsten byar sangs rgyas rnams kyis bsngags// gzungs ma 'di ni yid dga' ma// khyod kyis rtag tu bstan par bya// zhes brjod nas slob ma la gtad do// de nas rig mas/

bshang gci dag ni za ba dang*// khrag dang khu ba de bzhin te// sha chen bsten par bu spro 'am// bud med rnams la rtag gus dang*// bha ga'i padmar tsumba na// bu khyod ci dgar spro gyur tam// zhes dris pa'i lan du/ slob mas/ ji skad gsungs pa'i dam tshig la// bdag ni ci dgar spro gyur to// zhes lan btab pas lha mo de dgyes nas/ e ma nga yi padma 'di// bde ba thams cad kyi ni gnas// ci ste cho ga bzhin bsten na// de yi mdun na nga 'dug ste// sangs rgyas bsnyen pa la sogs pa// bya ba padmar ji bzhin byed// bde chen rgyal po rang nyid de// 'di nyid du ni rtag par bzhugs// blun po gang zhig 'di spong ba// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// ces gsung zhing slob ma'i pang du byon nas/ slar yang lha'i sku yab yum du gsal bar dmigs pa'i gnas lnga dang mkha' gsang byin gyis brlabs nas/ slob mas kun nas dkris pa dang bral zhing lhan cig skyes pa'i ye shes mngon du bya ba'i 'dun pas snyoms par zhugs pas sna tshogs pa dang*/ rnam par smin pa dang*/ rnam nyed dang mtshan nyid dang bral ba'i skad cig ma la dga' ba dang*/ mchog dga' dang*/ dga' bral gyi dga' ba dang*/ lhan cig skyes pa'i dga' ba rnams skyes pa ngo sprad cing slob mas kyang bde stong zung 'jug gi ngang la mnyam par bzhag go /de'i tshe nam mkha' gang ba'i dbang gi lha rnams kyis mchod pa'i char mngon par phab cing bkra shis kyi dbyangs brjod par bsam mo// de nas/ thabs gzhan gyis ni 'tshang mi rgya// gnyis su med pa'i chos kun ni// gnyis kyi dngos pos mtshon gyur pa// de phyir rig ma 'di ni mchog /de bas khyed kyis rtag tu ni// 'khor ba bral bar mi bya'o// 'di ni sangs rgyas thams cad kyi// rig pa'i brtul zhugs bla na med// rmongs pa gang zhig 'da' byed na// de la mchog gi dngos grub med// ces pa dang*/ ji ltar dbang bskur tshul la ni// sangs rgyas la sogs kun thob pa// de ltar byang chub spyod sogs dang*// dge ba'i tshul gzhan dag gis min// bdag po'i dam tshig bsrung bar bya// rtag tu sdom pa bskyang bar bya// bza' ba sha lnga bdud rtsi ste// bsrung ba 'di las dam tshig gzhan// dkon mchog 'jig gsod bud med kun// gzhan las len dang ngag gi brdzun// rnal 'byor rgyud du gang bshad pa// de yang cho ga bzhin du bsrung*// zhes che ba brjod pa dang dam tshig bstan nas/
